verdict_summary: Direct E[r_factor,t+1] forecasting from rich exogenous variables, discovered via ML across 6 independent economic-logic backbones (crowding/dispersion/funding-credit/crash-risk/cross-factor/macro), FAILS to beat the WT-005 factor-momentum baseline OOS and fails oos_retention. On the identical 163-mo OOS window (2012-12..2026-06): NO forecasting config beats factor-momentum (best GBM_seed0 paired_vs_mom_t=-0.359<0; ensemble -0.736; EN-combined -2.079). Every economic logic's ML-selected combo has oos_retention<0 (all <0.5 unconditional FAIL). ML combo-search DSR sweep 0.419<0.5 (n_trials=9). PIT-clean (lag-1 stress 1.127->0.766 gentle, no collapse; macro conditioning-only; walk-forward IS-only selection). Honest nuance: GBM (nonlinear, credit-spread-change + cross-factor-correlation + dispersion combos) clearly beats STATIC (paired_vs_static 1.85) and modestly improves crisis defense (AX-001 crisis active 0.29% vs momentum 0.10%/mo) — exogenous forecasting is informative but DOMINATED by the parameter-free momentum tilt and cannot cross oos_retention. This completes the comprehensive characterization: factor-timing-via-prediction in KR is bounded by OOS realizability / post-2020 cohort-wide factor decay (smart-beta 13-agent finding confirmed at the forecasting-model level), not by a lack of predictors.
